name: Can I rent out my ADU or converted garage in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Can I rent out my ADU or converted garage in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in Los Angeles, you are generally permitted to rent out your ADU or converted garage, subject to local regulations. ADUs are seen as a way to address housing needs. However, specific rules regarding short-term rentals (like Airbnb) versus long-term rentals may apply and can change. It is advisable to consult current city ordinances or a legal professional to understand any restrictions or requirements, such as tenant protections, that might impact your ability to rent the unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, ADUs and converted garages can generally be rented out in Los Angeles, but specific regulations for short-term vs. long-term rentals may apply.
